classification.difficultyReason: Convert horizontal separation into a change in intercept using the common gradient.

content.prompt: The horizontal distance between the parallel lines below is 2. If the equation of one of the lines is $y=2x-1$, find the equation of the other line.

spec.description: Two rising parallel lines; the left line crosses the y-axis above the origin and the right line below. A horizontal segment below the x-axis joins the lines and is labelled 2. No numeric axis ticks.
spec.mathematics: Equal gradients of 2 and horizontal separation 2. The required line is a translation of the given line 2 units left.
spec.answerVisibility: The question figure displays only source givens, axes and the separation label.

answer.worked:
The diagram shows the other line 2 units to the left of $y=2x-1$. A point $(x,y)$ on the other line corresponds to $(x+2,y)$ on the given line.

$$\begin{align*}y&=2(x+2)-1\\y&=2x+4-1\\y&=2x+3\end{align*}$$
